t.7173-51-5.agn: The pure substance is corrosive (Skin Corr. 1B). In the EU, as a disinfectant active substance, it requires approval under the biocidal products legislation.
t.7173-51-5.reg.clp: EU binding (harmonised) classification, CLP Annex VI index no 612-131-00-6 (CLP00): Acute Tox. 4 (Oral)*, Skin Corr. 1B.
t.7173-51-5.reg.det: Must be listed on the detergent label as a disinfectant, whatever its concentration.
t.7173-51-5.summary: A cationic disinfectant from the quaternary ammonium group.
t.7173-51-5.what: Kills bacteria, fungi and some viruses.
